arguments.text:
# Breakout

The player slides a paddle along the bottom of the screen to keep a ball in play while it breaks a wall of bricks for points.

## How it plays

The ball sets off up and to the right as soon as the level starts, and it starts out fast. It bounces off the edges of the screen with a knock and off every brick it hits. Each brick breaks with a sound when the ball hits it and adds 10 to the score.

The player moves the paddle with the left and right arrow keys, and it stops at the edges of the screen. When the ball hits the paddle, it bounces back up with a little extra push upwards. If the ball gets going too fast sideways, it settles back to a steadier speed.

## Level 1

The first level has a wall of 36 bricks with 4 gold bricks among them, the paddle, and the ball.

## Score and lives

The score and the lives (3 at the start) show in the top-left corner. When the lives run out, the game goes to the game-over screen.

## Words

- **Ball**: Ball
- **Paddle**: Paddle
- **Brick**: Brick
- **Gold brick**: GoldBrick
- **Score and lives**: Game
- **Level 1**: level-1
